label: First fed-back copy input (step L+1, echoing orig(0)) in long sequences, mainly L=9
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (99.6% of mass) at step t = L+1, where the input is the model echoing back original token 0 and it is outputting token 1. Strongly gated by sequence length: 82% of mass at L=9 (58% of L=9 sequences fire), 16% at L=8, ~1% at L=7, none for L<=6. Never fires in the original phase, on <DEL>, or on later copy steps. Magnitude is modulated by the identity of the echoed first token: o, l, x (then c, i, n, v) give the largest activations (all top examples are L=9 with first token o/l/x); adding a first-token set raises dev F1 only from 0.65 to ~0.69. Precision is incomplete because many L=9 sequences with other first tokens stay below threshold.
